The failure isn't caused by anything in the repo's code — it's the VS Code Vitest extension trying to spawn ~90 separate worker processes (one per discovered `vite.config.ts` across the monorepo) nearly simultaneously through vite-plus 0.3.1's `node` shim. macOS's launchd caps GUI apps (including VS Code) at a **256 file-descriptor soft limit** (`launchctl limit maxfiles` → 256), independent of your shell's `ulimit -n` (1048575). That many concurrent spawns exhausts the limit and Node's `child_process.spawn` fails with `EBADF`.

The repo's root [vite.config.ts](vite.config.ts#L14-L25) already includes tests from every package/format/renderer/etc., so a single root config is sufficient — the extension doesn't need to resolve all 90 per-package configs individually. I'll point the Vitest extension at just the root config.

**Root cause:** not a repo code bug. The Vitest extension enumerates every `vite.config.ts` in the monorepo (~90) and spawns a worker per config concurrently via vite-plus 0.3.1's `node` shim. macOS's launchd caps GUI-app processes (VS Code included) at 256 open file descriptors (`launchctl limit maxfiles`), regardless of your shell's much higher `ulimit -n`. That many near-simultaneous spawns exhausts the descriptor budget, and Node's `child_process.spawn` surfaces that as `EBADF`.

**Fix applied:** added `vitest.rootConfig`/`vitest.ignoreWorkspace` to [.vscode/settings.json](.vscode/settings.json) so the extension resolves one config instead of ~90.

If you still want per-package test explorer granularity later, the alternative is raising the launchd `maxfiles` soft limit (requires a LaunchDaemon plist + reboot/logout) — let me know if you'd like that instead/also.
